title: GitHub Actions CI/CD
description: Automate builds, tests, and deployments with GitHub Actions — workflows, jobs, matrix, secrets, and caching.

entries.label: Basic CI Workflow
entries.command:
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 20 }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
entries.description: Minimal CI workflow that runs tests on every push and PR

entries.label: Matrix Strategy
entries.command:
strategy:
  matrix:
    node-version: [18, 20, 22]
    os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
steps:
  - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
    with: { node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }} }
entries.description: Test across multiple versions and operating systems in parallel

entries.label: Cache Dependencies
entries.command:
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/.npm
    key: npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
    restore-keys: npm-
entries.description: Cache npm/pnpm packages to speed up CI runs

entries.label: Secrets
entries.description: Access encrypted secrets configured in repository settings

entries.label: Deploy on Tag
entries.command:
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./deploy.sh
entries.description: Trigger deployment only when a version tag (v1.0.0) is pushed

entries.label: Upload Artifact
entries.command:
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: build-output
    path: dist/
entries.description: Save build output so other jobs or humans can download it

entries.label: Conditional Step
entries.command:
- name: Deploy
  if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
  run: ./deploy.sh
entries.description: Run a step only on pushes to main branch (skip PRs)

entries.label: Docker Build & Push
entries.description: Build Docker image and push to GitHub Container Registry

entries.label: Concurrency (Cancel Previous)
entries.description: Cancel previous workflow runs for the same branch — saves CI minutes

entries.label: Reusable Workflow
entries.command:
# .github/workflows/reusable-test.yml
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      node-version: { type: string, default: '20' }
entries.description: Create reusable workflows that other repos or workflows can call
